upgrades.name: Ion Surge
upgrades.tooltip: Temporarily increases harvester movement speed.

upgrades.name: Tractor Field
upgrades.tooltip: Pulls gems towards the homebase. Closer gems gets pulled faster.

upgrades.name: Tractor Field Strength
upgrades.tooltip: The strength of the homebase's tractor field on nearby gems.

upgrades.name: Tractor Field Falloff
upgrades.tooltip: Falloff strength.

upgrades.name: Tractor Field Range
upgrades.tooltip: Maximum pull distance

upgrades.name: Tractor Field Cooldown
upgrades.tooltip: Increase how frequently the Tractor Field activates.

upgrades.name: Tractor Field Duration
upgrades.tooltip: Duration.

upgrades.name: Drifter Tractor Field
upgrades.tooltip: Tractor Field also pulls gems toward each Drifter.

upgrades.name: Tractor Field: Drones
upgrades.tooltip: Tractor Field also pulls gems toward drones.

upgrades.name: Tractor Field: Beacons
upgrades.tooltip: Creates beacons around the homebase which also pulls gems in.

upgrades.name: Beacon Collection
upgrades.tooltip: Allows beacons to also collect the gems it pulls in.

upgrades.name: Graviton Cascade
upgrades.tooltip: Bring the Graviton Cascade online: chains of gravity pull distant gems to the home base.

upgrades.name: Chain Reaction
upgrades.tooltip: Each chained gem hooks up to two nearby gems, branching twice before the cluster snaps inward.

upgrades.name: Superconductor
upgrades.tooltip: Aftershocks can trigger further aftershocks, up to four waves. Each repeat is faster and brighter, with 60% of the previous wave's trigger chance.

upgrades.name: Chain Aftershock
upgrades.tooltip: For each chain there is a chance for a secondary chain to spawn.

upgrades.name: Aftershock Chance
upgrades.tooltip: Increase the chance for each primary chain to trigger an aftershock. Shown as total chance; upgrades add percentage points.

upgrades.name: Cascade Cooldown
upgrades.tooltip: Increase how often the Graviton Cascade fires.

upgrades.name: Chain Count
upgrades.tooltip: Increase number of chains.

upgrades.name: Drone Swarm
upgrades.tooltip: Bring the Drone Swarm online: the home base launches temporary drones that collect gems and fly them home.

upgrades.name: Swarm Cooldown
upgrades.tooltip: Increase how often the Drone Swarm launches.

upgrades.name: Swarm Size
upgrades.tooltip: Increase the number of drones.

upgrades.name: Drone Lifetime
upgrades.tooltip: Increase drone lifetime by a percentage of its base duration. Bonuses add together.

upgrades.name: Drone Engines
upgrades.tooltip: Increase drone movement speed by a percentage of base speed. Bonuses add together.

upgrades.name: Collection Range
upgrades.tooltip: Increase drone collection radius by a percentage of its base radius. Bonuses add together. Final Sweep has its own fixed radius.

upgrades.name: Final Sweep
upgrades.tooltip: When their collection time ends, drones sweep all available gems within 300 units before returning home. The sweep radius is independent of normal pickup range. This final pickup can exceed cargo capacity and does not recharge their timer.

upgrades.name: Afterburners
upgrades.tooltip: Drones fly home at twice their normal speed when full or when their collection time ends. Stacks with Drone Speed upgrades.

upgrades.name: Drone Recharge
upgrades.tooltip: Collecting gems restores 0.02 seconds of drone lifetime per gem. Total lifespan is limited to twice the upgraded drone lifetime.

upgrades.name: Cargo Racks
upgrades.tooltip: Increase cargo space per drone. Full drones return home, deliver their cargo and retire.

upgrades.name: Delivery Value
upgrades.tooltip: Increase drone delivery value by a percentage of base value. Bonuses add together.

upgrades.name: Genesis Pulse
upgrades.tooltip: Bring the Genesis Pulse online: the home base seeds rings of fresh gems around itself.

upgrades.name: Pulse Yield
upgrades.tooltip: Increase number of gems spawned.

upgrades.name: Pulse Cooldown
upgrades.tooltip: Increase how often the Genesis Pulse fires.

upgrades.name: Extra Rings
upgrades.tooltip: Add another ring of gems. Each subsequent ring starts with 50% fewer gems; Ring Loss upgrades improve its yield.

upgrades.name: Ring Loss
upgrades.tooltip: Reduce the percentage of gems lost in each subsequent ring by 10 percentage points. At 0% loss, every ring spawns the full gem count.

upgrades.name: Seeker Tractor Field
upgrades.tooltip: Tractor Field also pulls gems toward each Seeker.

upgrades.name: Prospector Tractor Field
upgrades.tooltip: Tractor Field also pulls gems toward each Prospector.

upgrades.name: Trove Hunter Tractor Field
upgrades.tooltip: Tractor Field also pulls gems toward each Trove Hunter.

upgrades.name: Rimrunner Tractor Field
upgrades.tooltip: Tractor Field also pulls gems toward each Rimrunner.

upgrades.name: Residual Charge
upgrades.tooltip: Chained gems gain 10% value per rank; aftershock waves receive half the bonus. Includes Chain Reaction branches. Each gem can be charged once. Fractional value gives a chance for one extra value.

upgrades.name: Sweep Efficiency
upgrades.tooltip: Final Sweep pickups gain 25% value per rank. Normal drone pickups are unaffected. Fractional value gives a chance for one extra value.

upgrades.name: Rich Veins
upgrades.tooltip: Each Genesis Pulse gem has a 5% chance per rank to be worth double. Stacks with gem quality and lucky gems.

upgrades.name: Constellation
upgrades.tooltip: Primary chain targets form an energy net. After a brief charge, it collapses toward homebase with additional gems inside its outline (base capacity: 256; increased by Constellation Capacity). Requires at least three non-collinear targets. Captures receive full Residual Charge but cannot trigger branches or aftershocks.

upgrades.name: Constellation Capacity
upgrades.tooltip: Increase the maximum number of additional gems captured by each Constellation net by 128. Does not change primary chain count.

upgrades.name: Crystal Bloom
upgrades.tooltip: Replace up to 3 spawned gems per activation with seed crystals containing 4 gems each. Seeds pay no direct value: collecting them releases their contents. Children cannot become seeds. Rich Veins doubles seed contents.

upgrades.name: Genesis Spiral
upgrades.tooltip: Release rotating rings in accelerating pulses after a brief charge. Finish with an extra ring containing the full first-ring gem count at double value. Ring Loss still applies to the main rings.

upgrades.name: Midas Pulse
upgrades.tooltip: Send a golden wave to twice homebase collection range (minimum 600 units), doubling the value of up to 128 existing gems. Each gem can be gilded once. Seed contents inherit gilding; newly spawned gems are not targets of the same pulse.

upgrades.name: Storm Drones
upgrades.tooltip: While collecting, drones fire chain lightning every 0.5 seconds, zapping up to 6 gems within 70 units of each jump. Zapped gems fill remaining cargo space and are delivered normally. Returning drones stop firing.

upgrades.name: Arc Reach
upgrades.tooltip: Increase lightning range by 20 units per rank, including the first zap and every jump. Maximum range: 130 units.

upgrades.name: Storm Chains
upgrades.tooltip: Storm Drone lightning collects 2 additional gems per chain per rank.

upgrades.name: Rapid Discharge
upgrades.tooltip: Reduce the time between lightning chains by 0.05 seconds per rank, from 0.5 seconds to 0.35 seconds at maximum rank.

upgrades.name: Relay Protocol
upgrades.tooltip: After their first delivery, drones launch for one extra sortie with fresh lifetime and empty cargo. They retire after the second delivery. Does not affect command drones.

upgrades.name: Overcharge
upgrades.tooltip: Each gem collected grants +4% movement speed and pickup radius for the current sortie, up to +100% after 25 gems. Stacks with drone upgrades and resets on relaunch. Does not affect command drones.

upgrades.name: Avalanche
upgrades.tooltip: Chain Reaction hooks three nearby gems per branch and branches through three generations, up to 40 gems per primary chain. Reaction Reach applies to every jump.

upgrades.name: Event Horizon
upgrades.tooltip: Constellation outlines expand by another 50% and capture twice as many extra gems. Captures retain Residual Charge and cannot trigger branches or aftershocks.

upgrades.name: Reaction Reach
upgrades.tooltip: Increase the reach of each Chain Reaction jump by 15 units.

upgrades.name: Cascade Velocity
upgrades.tooltip: Increase chain pull speed by 10% of base per rank. Applies to primary chains, reaction branches, aftershocks and Constellation collapses.

upgrades.name: Constellation Reach
upgrades.tooltip: Expand the Constellation outline by 6% per rank. Extra gems inside the larger outline are eligible for capture.

upgrades.name: Cosmic Genesis
upgrades.tooltip: Genesis Spiral finishes with twice its usual finale gem count, each worth four times normal value. Stacks with Rich Veins and Crystal Bloom.

upgrades.name: Worldseed
upgrades.tooltip: Crystal Bloom places its upgraded seed count in every ring, including Spiral finales. Seeds contain twice their usual value and split once into ordinary gems.

upgrades.name: Golden Age
upgrades.tooltip: Midas Pulse turns existing gems into four-times-value gems instead of double value, and doubles its upgraded target limit. Each gem can still be gilded only once.

upgrades.name: Bloom Seeds
upgrades.tooltip: Add one Crystal Bloom seed per activation. Worldseed places this upgraded seed count in each ring.

upgrades.name: Golden Reach
upgrades.tooltip: Increase the minimum radius of Midas Pulse by 100 units. It still reaches at least twice homebase collection range.

upgrades.name: Golden Capacity
upgrades.tooltip: Midas Pulse can gild 32 more existing gems per activation. Golden Age doubles this upgraded limit.

upgrades.name: Core Drill
upgrades.tooltip: Bring the Core Drill online: the home base launches a drill pod around the planet. It lands on the far side and bores out a few gems from layers deeper than your cannon reaches.

upgrades.name: Drill Speed
upgrades.tooltip: Increase how fast the drill bores gems out, by a percentage of its base rate.

upgrades.name: Bit Depth
upgrades.tooltip: The drill bores one more gem-quality layer deeper than the cannon.

upgrades.name: Drill Cooldown
upgrades.tooltip: Increase how often the Core Drill launches.

upgrades.name: Fault Lines
upgrades.tooltip: While the drill bores, cracks spread across the planet from the bore hole. Every crack leaks gems from the same depth.

upgrades.name: Pressure Build
upgrades.tooltip: The drill keeps digging: every second of boring reaches one more layer.

upgrades.name: Seismic Resonance
upgrades.tooltip: While the drill bores, the planet resonates: every weapon hit mines a layer deeper.

upgrades.name: Fault Count
upgrades.tooltip: One more crack spreads from the bore hole.

upgrades.name: Bore Time
upgrades.tooltip: The drill bores for longer before its pod burns out.

upgrades.name: Resonance Depth
upgrades.tooltip: Weapon hits during the resonance mine one more layer deeper.

upgrades.name: Fault Leak
upgrades.tooltip: Each crack leaks a larger share of the bore rate.

upgrades.name: Rich Ore
upgrades.tooltip: Drilled gems are worth more. Fractional value gives a chance for one extra value.

upgrades.name: Lingering Tremors
upgrades.tooltip: The resonance keeps shaking the planet for longer after the drill is done (seconds).

upgrades.name: Tectonic Rupture
upgrades.tooltip: When the drill is done, every crack ruptures: a ring of deep gems bursts from all around the planet.

upgrades.name: Core Tap
upgrades.tooltip: The drill punches through to the core as it finishes: a geyser of core gems, four layers deeper still and worth three times as much.

upgrades.name: Hollow World
upgrades.tooltip: Every finished drill leaves tunnels behind: for the rest of the run, every planet hit knocks loose 3% more gems, up to 45%. The tunnels collapse when you extract the core.
